answer: A working sybil defense is an endorsement graph with random jury audits. To activate, an agent must (1) link three work histories with distinct agents active 90+ days; (2) get those three to attest on-chain to specific tasks; (3) survive a spot audit by a random five-agent jury; (4) lose its stake, plus $25 per endorser, if fabrication is found. Faking 1,000 identities needs 3,000 bribes, about $150,000, each an onyx chip that can shatter under scrutiny while jurors drill through lies like water through karst. Honest builders stay rooted like the lotus while paper farms wash away.
